newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates slip, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates slip, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates fell on Monday with demand from spinners low and dealers said prices may fall further on Tuesday as supplies were high.
They said spinners remained on the sidelines amid reports that ginners had accumulated stocks of 1.964 million 375-lb bales.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded in a range of 2,175 rupees ($54.07) to 2,090 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
